risks.title: Impairment of long-lived assets

risks.title: Accounting for real estate acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: The process of acquiring and accounting for real estate involves judgments on the fair value of tangible and intangible assets. Incorrect judgments could affect the presentation of financial statements.

risks.title: Accounting for foreclosed properties
risks.score_rationale: The accounting for properties acquired through foreclosure or deed in lieu is based on fair value. The difference between the loan's amortized cost and fair value could result in gains or losses.

risks.title: Climate disclosure regulations

risks.title: New accounting standards on expense disaggregation
